svg.title: Diagram of the contact routes on USPS pages. Phone: the Customer Care Center at 1-800-ASK-USPS (1-800-275-8777), a tracking line at 1-800-222-1811 and Technical Support at 1-800-344-7779, all open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 8:30 PM Eastern and Saturday 8 AM to 6 PM Eastern. Email Us: pick a topic, either where is my package, where is my mail, USPS.com technical issues, personnel, postal facility, or permits and bulk mail. Complaints: the station manager at the Post Office, then Consumer Affairs or the Office of the Consumer Advocate; the Inspector General for theft, fraud or waste by USPS staff; the Postal Inspection Service for mail fraud or theft by outsiders; the Postal Regulatory Commission for policy changes. The pages differ on mail theft, Informed Delivery help, tracking questions and TTY.
svg.text: USPS Customer Service
What the USPS and USAGov pages say
1. Phone
Customer Care Center: 1-800-ASK-USPS
(1-800-275-8777). Tracking line:
1-800-222-1811. Technical Support:
1-800-344-7779. Same hours for all three:
Mon-Fri 8 AM-8:30 PM ET, Sat 8 AM-6 PM ET.
2. Email Us: the topic decides
Where is my package? Where is my mail?
USPS.com technical issue. Personnel.
Postal facility. Permits and bulk mail.
3. Complaints and escalation
Station manager at the Post Office, then
Consumer Affairs or the Consumer Advocate.
Theft, fraud or waste by USPS staff: OIG.
Mail fraud or theft by outsiders: Postal
Inspection Service. Policy changes: PRC.
Where the pages differ
Mail theft: Email Us topic or Inspection
Service. Informed Delivery help: USPS.com
topic or its own email. Tracking: Email Us
topic or a separate phone line. TTY: 711 or
state relay service, not a USPS representative.
Sources: USPS.com Contact Us; USPS Email Us;
USAGov (updated Sep. 4, 2026); read Nov. 26, 2026
